---
title: "Step 2 - Multiple Linear Regression (Starter Model)"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

## **Global**

```{r, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(scales)

Data <- read_csv("project_traindata.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

CategoricalVars <- c("make", "segment", "transmission", "fuel_type", "province",
                     "service_history", "accident_history", "seller_type", "colour")

DropVars <- c("model_year")

TrainShare <- 0.80
```

## **Preparing the Data**

#### 1.Training and validation sets (same as Step 1)

```{r}
Data <- Data %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CategoricalVars), ~ fct_infreq(factor(.x))))

ModelData <- Data %>%
  select(-all_of(DropVars))

set.seed(244)

n <- nrow(ModelData)
TrainRows <- sample(1:n, size = floor(TrainShare * n), replace = FALSE)

TrainingData   <- ModelData[TrainRows, ] %>% select(-listing_id)
ValidationData <- ModelData[-TrainRows, ] %>% select(-listing_id)

stopifnot(nrow(TrainingData) == 1695, nrow(ValidationData) == 424)
```

#### 2.Warranty as yes/no

```{r}
add_warranty_flag <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    mutate(has_warranty = factor(if_else(warranty_months > 0, "Yes", "No"),
                                 levels = c("No", "Yes"))) %>%
    select(-warranty_months)
}

TrainingData   <- add_warranty_flag(TrainingData)
ValidationData <- add_warranty_flag(ValidationData)

TrainingData %>%
  group_by(vehicle_age) %>%
  summarise(Cars = n(), Percent_with_warranty = round(mean(has_warranty == "Yes") * 100, 1)) %>%
  filter(vehicle_age <= 8) %>%
  kable(caption = "Share of cars with a warranty by age (training set)")
```

## **Choosing the Response**

#### 3.price vs log(price)

```{r}
rmse_rand <- function(Model, df, LogResponse) {
  Predicted <- predict(Model, df)
  if (LogResponse) Predicted <- exp(Predicted)
  sqrt(mean((df$price - Predicted)^2))
}

skewness <- function(x) mean((x - mean(x))^3) / sd(x)^3

FullPrice <- lm(price ~ ., data = TrainingData)
FullLog   <- lm(log(price) ~ ., data = TrainingData)

tibble(
  Response           = c("price", "log(price)"),
  Adj_R2             = round(c(summary(FullPrice)$adj.r.squared,
                               summary(FullLog)$adj.r.squared), 3),
  Training_RMSE      = round(c(rmse_rand(FullPrice, TrainingData, FALSE),
                               rmse_rand(FullLog, TrainingData, TRUE))),
  Residual_skewness  = round(c(skewness(resid(FullPrice)), skewness(resid(FullLog))), 2)
) %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        caption = "Full model (all predictors) on the training set")
```

```{r, fig.height=3.5}
bind_rows(
  tibble(Response = "price",      Fitted = fitted(FullPrice), Residual = resid(FullPrice)),
  tibble(Response = "log(price)", Fitted = fitted(FullLog),   Residual = resid(FullLog))
) %>%
  mutate(Response = factor(Response, levels = c("price", "log(price)"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Fitted, y = Residual)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "red") +
  facet_wrap(~ Response, scales = "free") +
  labs(title = "Residuals vs fitted values", x = "Fitted value", y = "Residual") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## **Starter Model**

#### 4.Fitting the starter model

```{r}
StarterRecipe <- log(price) ~ vehicle_age + mileage + make + segment

StarterModel <- lm(StarterRecipe, data = TrainingData)
```

#### 5.Starter model summary

```{r}
tibble(
  Predictors    = length(coef(StarterModel)) - 1,
  Adj_R2        = round(summary(StarterModel)$adj.r.squared, 3),
  Residual_SE   = round(summary(StarterModel)$sigma, 3),
  Training_RMSE = round(rmse_rand(StarterModel, TrainingData, TRUE))
) %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
        caption = "Starter model on the training set")

summary(StarterModel)$coefficients %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
  mutate(Unit           = if_else(Term == "mileage", 10000, 1),
         Percent_effect = if_else(Term == "(Intercept)", NA_real_,
                                  round((exp(Estimate * Unit) - 1) * 100, 1)),
         Term           = if_else(Term == "mileage", "mileage (per 10,000 km)", Term),
         across(c(Estimate, `Std. Error`, `t value`), ~ signif(.x, 4)),
         `Pr(>|t|)` = signif(`Pr(>|t|)`, 3)) %>%
  select(-Unit) %>%
  kable(caption = "Starter model coefficients (Percent_effect = % change in price)")
```
